# Pipeline : Test Quantitatif

```{r}
# ==== Global Parameters ====
Level <- "Family"
level <- tolower(Level) # low case for genetical
Name <- "Fabaceae"
R_pixel <- 10 # Bota count radius
Marker <- "GH" # "18S" "ITS"

# ====  BOTA ====
## Select data
bota_focus <- select_tax(bota, Level, Name)
## Density grid
bota_grid <- bota_grid_NCI(bota_focus) # New model with NCI
## Plot
p1 <- plot_grid_stem(bota_grid,"density") +
  labs(title = "Bota density with R=10")

# ====  GENET ====
## Density grid
genet_grid <- genet_grid_read(Marker, Level, Name)
## Plot
p2 <- plot_grid_stem(genet_grid,"density")+
  labs(title = "eDNA density")

# ==== COMPARE ====
# Compare density grids
df_compare <- df_compare_join(genet_grid, bota_grid)
# Plot Compare
p3 <- plot_compare(df_compare)

# ==== Results ====
(p1 | p2 | p3) 
```
